name: Hok - Byarum
description: Hok to Byarum. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official connector is reported as 1.4 km in inventory, 1.6 km in description and 1.3 km in API according to agent reports.
Connector name says Byarum kyrka - HÖ20/HÖ22, but HÖ20 endpoint topology continues to HÖ21 and the connector is described from Byarum hembygdsgård to Byarum church/bus stop.
Smålandsleden/Länsstyrelsen describe Gärahovs as adjacent/connected and Höglandsleden passing beside the reserve, while WFS/GPX check found no direct mainline intersection, closest about 4 m.
OSM relation 15423266 has endpoints close to HÖ20 but is about 16.585 km, roughly 1.24 km longer than official GPX, and includes extra/disconnected context.
Official/facilities lanes report a water tap on the north side of Byarums hembygdsgård, but the rules lane did not confirm reliable official potable water at Byarum.
JLT confirms the bus stop but did not expose coordinates to the transit lane; coordinate is approximate from OSM road geometry.

facilities.name: Hok / Hook herrgård, ledentré HÖ19/HÖ20
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ19/HÖ20 entrance at Hook/Hok with parking, food, lodging and drinking-water/service context. Deduplicate with HÖ19. Preserve commercial/customer-service context for water, food, lodging and parking.

facilities.name: Hooks Herrgård
facilities.coordinateSource: Facilities lane; OSM and commercial/visitor sources
facilities.description: Commercial hotel, restaurant, spa and golf service near the HÖ20 start. Service hours, guest parking and water access may be customer-facing and seasonal/time-sensitive.

facilities.name: Sandsjön vindskydd
facilities.description: Newly built official shelter near Sandsjön bathing place, with nearby simple grill place and dry toilet. Fire use is overridden by live fire-ban status. Do not infer potable water from Sandsjön.

facilities.name: Avstickare Sandsjöns badplats
facilities.coordinateSource: Official nearby object/API site 136727, approximate marker context
facilities.description: Official 0.1 km side connection from HÖ20 to Sandsjön badplats/shelter context. Do not merge into HÖ20 mainline geometry.

facilities.name: Byarum, ledentré HÖ20/HÖ21
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ20/HÖ21 trail entrance by Byarums hembygdsgård, with roadside parking, seasonal cafe and water-tap context. Deduplicate with HÖ21. Official page says parking for about eight cars and 24-hour limit. Water tap public access/seasonality and exact tap coordinate need verification before final potable-water import.

facilities.name: Byarums hembygdsgård
facilities.coordinateSource: Facilities lane; OSM building and Vaggeryd/hembygd pages
facilities.description: Hembygdsgård by the Byarum endpoint with summer cafe/serving reported by official/local sources. Opening dates/hours are time-sensitive; facilities lane found summer daily 10-19 context and 2025 dates 14 June-17 August. Recheck before importing as active service.

facilities.name: Anslutning Byarum kyrka - HÖ20/HÖ22
facilities.description: Official access connector from Byarum hembygdsgård/ledentré to Byarum church and bus stop via Munkaleden. Connector name says HÖ20/HÖ22 even though the immediate section endpoint topology is HÖ20/HÖ21. Inventory says 0.6 km; description says 640 m.
